LESSON: DOMESTIC HYGIENE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Hygiene Practices
Topic 3.2: Domestic Hygiene

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Domestic Hygiene. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we maintain hygiene in the home environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment
2. use appropriate methods to clean home environment

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: DOMESTIC HYGIENE
Subject: AGRICULTURE · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Domestic Hygiene helps you succeed in AGRICULTURE. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: DOMESTIC HYGIENE
Domestic Hygiene is part of Science learning. Connect every idea to something you can observe.
Use safe examples only. Do not try dangerous experiments without a teacher.
Write definitions in your own words, then add one drawing or real-life example.

PART 1: Describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Domestic Hygiene” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Use appropriate methods to clean home environment

What this means
In this part you learn to use appropriate methods to clean home environment. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use appropriate methods to clean home environment.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Domestic Hygiene matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use appropriate methods to clean home environment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Domestic Hygiene is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

KEY FACTS: DOMESTIC HYGIENE

Domestic Hygiene is part of Science learning. Connect every idea to something you can observe.

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Domestic Hygiene” around your school. (skill: describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment)

Example 2: Say why Domestic Hygiene matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: use appropriate methods to clean home environment)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Domestic Hygiene to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment.
3. Practise this skill: use appropriate methods to clean home environment.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Domestic Hygiene from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Domestic Hygiene: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Domestic Hygiene?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we maintain hygiene in the home environment?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Domestic Hygiene means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment.
5. Be able to: use appropriate methods to clean home environment.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
